newsitem.title: SPAIN: Oldest woman in Spain dies at 113.
newsitem.headline: Oldest woman in Spain dies at 113.

text.p: The oldest woman in Spain has died at the age of 113 of natural causes, a municipal official said on Sunday.
Carmen Figueiro Freiria, known as the "grandmother of Spain", worked as a farmer and homemaker for most of her life and at 104 was still tending her garden, Spanish news reports said.

"She died at midnight in her home, without suffering from any special ailment," Jose Villar Pereira, mayor of Figueiro's hometown of Nigran, told reporters. "On the one hand, it is sad and on the other, there is a certain happiness because of her longevity."
Born October 28, 1883, Figueiro lived her whole life in the northwestern Spanish town of Nigran near Pontevdra where she died.
She grew up poor and at age 12, when her mother died, she left school to care for four younger siblings.
She had five children but only three are still living. She is also survived by 19 grandchildren, 40 great grandchildren and three great-great grandchildren.
